## Pre-launch design and preparations

- u4b tracker
  - [u4b-006](/_sources/u4b/u4b_006.qmd)
- zener diode regulation
- supercaps x2
- HF antenna - 20m band
- GPS antenna
- 2 balloons
  - [x] stretch
  - [x] leak test
  - [x] suck out air
- WSPR channel selection

## Launch checklist

### Pre-launch

- [x] check forecast for wind and clouds
- [x] fill balloons

### At launch site

- [x] verify wind and clouds OK
- [x] check payload voltage in sun
- [x] check WSPR transmissions on ground with SDR Rx

New payload design with 3 solar panels and zener diode.
